Action: [Answer]
Content: To pack a ceramic ornament, first wrap it in bubble wrap or soft cloth to prevent scratches. Place it in a sturdy box filled with packing peanuts or foam padding to cushion against impacts. Ensure the ornament is centered in the box and surrounded by padding on all sides to avoid shifting during transport. Seal the box securely with strong tape.
